response.justification: The candidate comfortably exceeds every technical requirement — strong TypeScript/Node.js, React, REST, relational databases, Kubernetes, AWS, and even the nice-to-have LLM/MCP agent experience. However, with nearly 20 years of experience and current Staff-level employment, he is significantly overqualified for an entry-level position, raising serious concerns about salary alignment, engagement, and retention in a junior/mid IC role.
strengths: Deep TypeScript/Node.js and React experience across multiple production platforms
Covers nearly all nice-to-haves: Kubernetes, AWS (CDK), LLM/MCP and AI-agent tooling
Proven fullstack ownership from backend/infrastructure to UI, plus mentoring ability
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level role; likely salary and retention mismatch
Currently employed as a Staff Engineer — motivation for a junior/mid position is unclear
No explicit PostgreSQL or Nest.js experience (MongoDB/MySQL-focused)

key_factors.factor: Complete coverage of required tech stack
